description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Awoken Tantalus], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Twin Element Mode (Wind, Poison) v2] to the user, causes [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)] and [Imperil Poison 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Wind 20% (25s)] and [Imperil Poison 20% (25s)] if 1/2+ IX characters are alive, grants [Instant Cast 1]/[Instant Cast 1] and [Weakness +30% Boost (15s)] to all allies if 3/4+ IX characters are alive

description.name: Awoken Tantalus
description.text: Wind and Poison abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind and Poison abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Wind, Poison) v2
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind]/[Attach Poison] after using a Wind/Poison ability

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Poison
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Poison damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Poison resistance +20%

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses
